make this a default? the table card keeps its own head and close button, so the inspector's title row (with fp-sheet-close) shows only for a zone or the room — reverse: add the row above the table card. (trigger: list) — reply: default yes run-list

decisions.text: behaviour: the table card keeps its own head and close button, so the inspector's title row (with fp-sheet-close) shows only for a zone or the room — reverse: add the row above the table card.
behaviour: pressing a legend chip or a zone on the map while the join tool is on switches back to the select tool — reverse: ignore the press in the join tool.
behaviour: a tap on a table in the zone tool does nothing (the tool only draws) — reverse: select the table.
behaviour: `withArea` op `color` with a value outside 0–7 is refused (returns null) like the other refused ops — reverse: store no colour instead.

removes: the old room card's name inputs, remove buttons and pending add-area row — names, colour and removal now live in the zone card, and the old `fp-multi` switch became the `fp-tool-join` tool, as the plan says — reverse: restore the old room-panel template.
seen: e2e/ui/699-3.spec.ts:30 — it hovers `room-area-remove`, which no longer exists (the bin is now `zone-remove` in the zone card); the file is outside this plan's scope, so I did not edit it.

behaviour: the map's zone shapes can be moved and resized while the zone tool is active (the page passes zoneEditable for every tool except join). Drawing needs zoneEditable, so this was the simplest fix — reverse: set zoneEditable in floor-plan.page.html back to canEdit_() && tool_() === 'select', which also turns drawing off again.
